1. **[blocking][issue-impact] F1 (high)** — Profile application loses an earlier region projection when multiple declared projections share a target. [`render_projections`](crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:497) derives every region from the unchanged overlay, then [`plan_profile_application_against`](crates/jit/src/profile/planner.rs:219) overwrites `desired[target]` per result. Thus a profile containing both `charter` and `invariants` projections for `AGENTS.md` retains only the last rendered region, unlike `jit project render`, which correctly threads pending target content. This creates projection drift. References: `@/invariant/single-source-prose`.

2. **[blocking][issue-impact] F2 (high)** — `full` projections bypass the generic source and scope validation required by the new config contract. [`render_projection_body`](crates/jit/src/validation/project_render.rs:83) sends `full` directly to [`render_full_body`](crates/jit/src/validation/project_render.rs:174), which neither verifies project scope nor reads the declared registry source. An issue-scoped kind pointed at an engine registry can render successfully, and a missing invariant registry becomes an empty successful render instead of the required typed missing-source error.
